newsitem.title: USA: Booby-trapped beeper blasts off woman's finger.
newsitem.headline: Booby-trapped beeper blasts off woman's finger.

text.p: A booby-trapped beeper, hand-delivered to a young waitress in a New York City cafe, exploded in her hands on Monday night, blasting off her right little finger, news reports said.
The woman, 25-year-old Tara Zukas, detonated the beeper when she changed the battery, screaming as it went off in her hands.
Quick-thinking patrons retrieved her finger and packed it in ice before the woman was rushed to Manhattan's Bellevue Hospital.

Police said the package containing the pager, addressed to both Zukas and her brother, had been delivered about a week ago. But it took the electrical current of a new battery to set off the blasting cap that had been hidden inside it.
Reports indicated that the bomb was probably intended for the victim's brother. A spokesman for the police department said it was possible she could lose between one and three of her fingers.
A Bellevue spokesman said the woman's condition was stable, and that she was expected to undergo hours of surgery as doctors treated her burns and tried to reconstruct her hand.
